common.contact_text: For any question, or to request access, correction or deletion of your data:

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: My2-0 (“we”, “the app”) is a platform for managing amateur sports clubs and competitions. This policy explains what data we collect, why, who we share it with, how long we keep it and how you control it.

sections.h: 1. Who is responsible for your data?

blocks.p: The publisher of My2-0 (Douala, Cameroon) is responsible for processing your account data. For data belonging to a group or a competition (squads, attendance, contributions, licences), the group manager or competition organiser decides how it is used within the platform; we host and protect it on their behalf.

ul: Name, first name, username, email address, password (stored encrypted, never in plain text)
Phone number (optional), date of birth, gender, city and neighbourhood of residence, region of origin (optional)
Profile photo (optional), position, strong foot, sports information you provide
Attendance, match participation, statistics (goals, assists, cards), rankings
Contributions, sanctions and cash movements of the group (tracking only)
Messages exchanged in group and private conversations
Photos and videos you post (highlights, match media)
Player and staff profiles of registered teams: name, date of birth, nationality, position, shirt number, phone, ID photo
Results, rankings, line-ups and statistics, visible on the public pages of a competition when it is public

blocks.p: If you use “Match check-in”, the app asks for your position once, in the foreground, when you tap the button, to confirm you are near the stadium. We never track your location in the background and do not use it for any other purpose.

ul: IP address (kept in abbreviated, hashed form for advertising statistics), device type, app version
Push notification token (Firebase Cloud Messaging)
Technical security and error logs
To create and secure your account and authenticate you
To run your group and competitions (schedules, line-ups, results, licences, rankings)
To send you useful notifications (call-ups, results, reminders) — you can turn them off in settings
To let members communicate
To display partner advertisements and measure their audience (see section 6)
To generate posters and player cards, including with the help of artificial intelligence (see section 5)
To moderate reported content and protect the community
To meet our legal obligations

blocks.p: My2-0 does not process any payment in the app. Contributions, entry fees and fines are only recorded for tracking; payments are made outside the app (cash, mobile money, bank transfer). No bank card number is collected.

sections.h: 5. Who we share your data with

blocks.p: We never sell your data. It is shared only:

ul: with the other members of your group and the managers of the competitions you take part in, according to your visibility settings;
publicly, for the information of a public competition (teams, players, results, rankings) and for your profile if you made it public;

with our technical providers, strictly to run the service: server hosting, Firebase / Google (push notifications), Cloudinary (image and video hosting), email server, and Google Gemini when you generate a poster with AI (the text and images you provide for that poster are sent to it);
if the law requires us to.

blocks.p: The app displays advertisements from local partners. They are not personalised based on your profile. We only measure how many times an ad is displayed or clicked, using an abbreviated, hashed device identifier. This detailed measurement is deleted after 90 days; aggregated daily totals are kept for 1 year. Partners only receive aggregated statistics, never personal data.

sections.h: 7. How long we keep your data

ul: Account data: as long as your account exists; erased when it is deleted (see section 9)
Password reset tokens: 15 minutes
Login session: 7 days, then you need to log in again
A group's match history, statistics and financial data: kept in anonymised form after an account is deleted, so as not to distort the group's history
Access and correction: view and edit your profile at any time in the app
Visibility: make your profile public or private in settings
Notifications: turn them off in the app or phone settings
Location: refuse or withdraw permission in your phone settings; only “Match check-in” is affected
Report and block: report a message, video or profile, and block a person
Deletion: see section 9
Copy of your data: write to us, we reply within 30 days

blocks.p: In the app: Settings → Delete my account. Without the app (or if you no longer have access): see the Account deletion page or write to us. Your personal information (name, contacts, photos, videos, notifications, preferences) is erased; the group's sports and financial history is kept in anonymised form.

Encrypted communications (HTTPS/TLS), encrypted passwords, role- and competition-based access control, login attempt limiting, time-limited sessions, messages encrypted at rest (AES-256). As no system is infallible, we encourage you to choose a unique password. Details in our security policy.

My2-0 is not intended for children under 13 and does not allow them to create an account. Minor players may appear in a team's squad: their profile is then entered by the team manager, who declares having the consent of their parents or guardians. A parent or guardian may request correction or deletion of a child's profile by writing to us.

Some providers (Google, Cloudinary) may process data outside Cameroon with contractual safeguards. If we make a significant change to this policy, we will notify you in the app; the update date appears at the top of this page.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By creating an account or using My2-0, you accept these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the app.

blocks.p: My2-0 helps amateur clubs and organisers manage their members, matches, attendance, group finances and competitions. The service is provided “as is”; we do our best to keep it available and accurate, without being able to guarantee uninterrupted operation.

ul: You must be at least 13 years old.
The information you provide must be accurate. An account is personal: do not share your password.
You are responsible for what is done with your account.
You can delete your account at any time (Settings → Delete my account).

sections.h: 3. User-generated content and rules of conduct

blocks.p: You remain the owner of the content you post (messages, photos, videos, announcements). You allow us to host it and display it to the people you intend it for, in order to run the service.
The following is prohibited and may be removed without notice:

ul: harassment, bullying, threats and violence
hateful or discriminatory language (origin, ethnicity, religion, gender, disability…)
sexual or inappropriate content, especially involving minors
impersonation, false information about a player or team
spam, unauthorised advertising, scam attempts
publishing someone else's personal data without their consent
any illegal activity or activity aimed at disrupting the service

blocks.p: You can report a message, video or profile, and block a person (their messages disappear from your screen) from the app. We review reports and may remove content, warn, suspend or delete an account. To challenge a decision, write to us.

ul: Managers are responsible for the information they enter about members, players and staff, and for having the consent of parents or guardians for minors.
A competition's rules (rankings, sanctions, fines, licences) are decided by its organiser: My2-0 provides the tool, not the refereeing.
Payments (contributions, entry fees, fines) take place outside the app; My2-0 is neither the collector nor the guarantor.

blocks.p: The app may display advertisements from partners, clearly identified. We are not responsible for the content of third-party sites or offers they link to.

To the extent permitted by law, My2-0 is not liable for indirect losses, for data loss due to a cause beyond our control, or for decisions made by group managers or organisers. This does not limit any right the law gives you.
We may suspend or delete an account that breaches these terms. You may stop using My2-0 and delete your account at any time.
We may update these terms; in case of a significant change we will notify you in the app. They are governed by Cameroonian law; in case of a dispute, we first seek an amicable solution.

security.title: Security Policy
security.intro: These are the measures we apply to protect your data, and how to report a problem to us.

ul: All communications go through HTTPS (TLS).
Passwords are stored in encrypted (hashed) form, never in plain text.
Conversation messages are encrypted in our database (AES-256-GCM); they can only be read through the application.
Login sessions expire after 7 days; they are closed automatically when no longer valid.
Repeated login attempts are limited (protection against guessed passwords); reset requests are limited too.
Access is controlled by role and, for competitions, by permission: everyone can only do the actions granted to them, and nobody can grant themselves more rights than they have.
Our servers' keys and secrets are never embedded in the app.
We regularly verify access rights with automated tests.
Choose a long, unique password.
Log out on shared devices.
Never share your password; My2-0 will never ask you for it.
Be wary of links received from strangers.
Report any abusive content or behaviour from the app.

blocks.p: If you discover a security flaw, write to contact@my2-0.cloud with the subject “Security” and the steps to reproduce it. Please do not publish the flaw before we have been able to fix it, and do not access other users' data. We acknowledge receipt within 72 hours.

deletion.title: Account and Data Deletion
deletion.intro: You can delete your My2-0 account and personal data at any time. This page is also for those who no longer have access to the app.

ul: Open My2-0 and log in.
Go to Settings.
Tap Delete my account, choose a reason (optional), type “delete” to confirm.
Your account is deleted immediately and you are logged out.

blocks.p: Write to contact@my2-0.cloud with the subject “Account deletion”, from your account's email address, stating your username. We verify your identity and delete your account within 30 days.

ul: Your personal information: name, email, phone, date of birth, any ID document
Your photos, videos and messages
Your notifications, notification tokens and preferences
Your access and roles in groups and competitions
A group's match history, attendance statistics and financial data, in anonymised form (not linked to your identity), so as not to distort other members' history

blocks.p: To delete the profile of a child registered in a team, a parent or guardian can write to us at the same address.
